# Tanmay Bagaria

> Personal website and writing by Tanmay Bagaria, a software engineer working on backend systems, streaming systems, databases, vector search, and AI agents.

This site is a compact portfolio and writing archive. The most useful content for language models and agents is linked below.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tanmay.js.org/): Background, work, selected projects, reading list, writing, and travel notes.
- [Kafka Transactions](https://tanmay.js.org/kafka-transactions.html): Explanation of Kafka transactional producers, transaction coordinator state, producer epochs, transaction metadata, commit or abort markers, and `read_committed` visibility.

## Contact

- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tanmaybagaria/): Professional profile.
